title: A unified quantum rate theory of electron transfer: conceptual advances in quantum electrochemistry
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1803-1812
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01301A, Viewpoint
Paulo Roberto Bueno
Quantum-rate theory requires a null electrochemical potential for peak electron-transfer efficiency. This aligns with semi-classical maximum-rate predictions, thereby facilitating the observed quantum coherence.
